# GigChain Keys

> GigChain Keys is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) MainStage alternative for Windows, macOS and Linux: a live-performance rig for keyboard players. It hosts VST3 and VST2 instruments and effects, keeps a setlist with each song's sounds loaded up front (instant, gapless sound changes), layers and splits the keyboard, shows chord and lyric charts on stage, and has built-in pianos, synths, pads and a SoundFont player. No ads, no account, no licence key.

Apple's MainStage runs only on a Mac. On Windows and Linux, GigChain Keys does the same job: setlists of songs and sounds, a mixer with channel strips and effects, keyboard splits and layers, MIDI Learn, a full-screen Perform mode for touch screens, a live looper, and a practice mode with scored daily warm-ups. New versions come out every Monday.

## Download

- [Download page (Windows installer and portable zip, macOS Apple Silicon disk image, Linux AppImage and .deb)](https://xdarkzx.github.io/GigChain-Keys/)
